map.建议设置。有效期能控制发放节奏与流失风险，也让囤码倒卖变得困难。实现上应把过期时: Yes, set one. An expiry controls the pace of distribution and the risk of churn, and it makes hoarding codes for resale harder. Implement it by storing the expiry in the database rather than encoding it into the code itself — a date inside the code string lets others infer the pattern, and a rule change would break codes already issued.
